image.name: jackett
image.description: [Jackett](https://github.com/Jackett/Jackett) works as a proxy server: it translates queries from apps (Sonarr, SickRage, CouchPotato, Mylar, etc) into tracker-site-specific http queries, parses the html response, then sends results back to the requesting software. This allows for getting recent uploads (like RSS) and performing searches. Jackett is a single repository of maintained indexer scraping & translation logic - removing the burden from other apps.

changelog.desc: Rebase to Alpine 3.19. Deprecate development tag as upstream is publishing nightly stable releases.
Add icu-data-full to address [ICU issue](https://github.com/Jackett/Jackett/issues/14008) with Cyrillic character sets.
Rebase to Alpine 3.17, migrate to s6v3.
Allow user to optionally enable auto updates.
Switching to new Base images, shift to arm32v7 tag.
Switch to net-core builds of jackett, not dependant on mono and smaller images.
Add pipeline logic and multi arch.
Ensure root ownership of Jackett files.
Switch to using inhouse mono baseimage, ubuntu xenial based.
Call python2 from edge main to satisfy new mono dependency.
Rebase to alpine linux for smaller image.

env_vars.name: AUTO_UPDATE
env_vars.desc: Allow Jackett to update inside of the container.

env_vars.name: RUN_OPTS
env_vars.desc: Optionally specify additional arguments to be passed.

volumes.desc: Where Jackett should store its config file.

image.title: Jackett
image.setup_instructions:
The web interface is at `<your-ip>:9117` , configure various trackers and connections to other apps there.
More info at [Jackett](https://github.com/Jackett/Jackett).

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  jackett:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/jackett:latest
    container_name: jackett
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - AUTO_UPDATE=true #optional
      - RUN_OPTS= #optional
    volumes:
      - /path/to/jackett/data:/config
      - /path/to/blackhole:/downloads
    ports:
      - 9117:9117
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=jackett \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -e AUTO_UPDATE=true `#optional` \
  -e RUN_OPTS= `#optional` \
  -p 9117:9117 \
  -v /path/to/jackett/data:/config \
  -v /path/to/blackhole:/downloads \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/jackett:latest
